question_it_answers: Do reviewers agree with each other beyond chance?
how_to_compute: Alpha over all reviews of the period, per site or team; handles many reviewers and missing ratings
notes: 0.80 = reliable; 0.67-0.80 = tentative; below 0.67 = investigate. When errors are rare (<10%), alpha runs low even for good reviewers; judge together with sensitivity_vs_gold

how_to_compute: Cohen's kappa for each reviewer pair with 30+ shared cases; report the average and the lowest pair
notes: Use to find which pairs or people drive low alpha

question_it_answers: How often do reviewers give the same label?
how_to_compute: Share of reviewer pairs on the same case with the same label
notes: Never report alone: with few AI errors it is high even when reviewers are not checking

question_it_answers: Do reviewers catch the AI errors that experts confirm?
how_to_compute: On the golden set: reviews labelled 'Error' / reviews of true errors; show a 95% CI
notes: The single most important correctness number when errors are rare

question_it_answers: Do reviewers avoid flagging correct AI decisions?
how_to_compute: On the golden set: reviews labelled 'Correct' / reviews of truly correct decisions
notes: Low specificity wastes rework; high specificity alone means little

question_it_answers: How many true errors pass oversight unflagged?
how_to_compute: On the golden set: true errors where every reviewer said 'Correct' / true errors with 2+ reviews
notes: Multiply by the AI error rate x 1000 for errors slipping through per 1000 decisions

question_it_answers: Is every decision actually reviewed as designed?
how_to_compute: Decisions with 2+ usable reviews / all decisions (after removing blanks and duplicates)
notes: Skipped and 'Unsure' reviews reduce real coverage

question_it_answers: Are the decisions that matter most double-reviewed?
how_to_compute: Same as above for the top 10% of decisions by value or risk
notes: Define 'high stakes' with the business owner

metric: True errors in the golden set (per site)
question_it_answers: Is the golden set big enough to judge correctness?
how_to_compute: Count of expert-confirmed errors in each site's golden sample
notes: With rare errors you need many gold cases; below 15 errors the catch rate is a rough guide only
